blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Max Verstappen won a wet and wild Singapore Grand Prix sprint race for Red Bull on Saturday after George Russell crashed his Mercedes when leading at the end of the opening lap. Verstappen held off Ferrari’s Lewis Hamilton to win by 2.591sec with Charles Leclerc third as the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri touched and spun on the final lap when fourth and fifth. A heavy shower 10 minutes before the scheduled start meant a delay of 30 minutes.
